subject: Computação
description_pt: Comparar diferentes casos particulares (instâncias) de um mesmo problema, identificando as semelhanças e diferenças entre eles, e criar um algoritmo para resolver todos, fazendo uso de variáveis (parâmetros) para permitir o tratamento de todos os casos de forma genérica. Empregar diferentes estratégias da Computação (decomposição, generalização e reúso) para construir a solução de problemas.

components.description_pt: Comparar instâncias específicas de um problema para identificar similaridades e diferenças entre elas
components.description_en: Compare specific instances of a problem to identify similarities and differences among them
components.cc_component_description: Compare data sets collected by different groups to identify similarities and differences in findings

components.description_pt: Usar variáveis como parâmetros para generalizar um algoritmo que resolve todas as instâncias de um problema
components.description_en: Use variables as parameters to generalize an algorithm that solves all instances of a problem
components.cc_component_description: Construct a step-by-step algorithm to solve a clearly defined problem

components.description_pt: Decompor problema complexo do mundo real em sub-problemas menores e independentemente solúveis
components.description_en: Decompose a complex real-world problem into smaller, independently solvable sub-problems
components.cc_component_description: Decompose a complex real-world problem into smaller, independently solvable sub-problems

components.description_pt: Construir um algoritmo genérico que trata múltiplos casos do mesmo problema
components.description_en: Construct a generic algorithm that handles multiple cases of the same problem
components.cc_component_description: Construct a step-by-step algorithm to solve a clearly defined problem

cc_matches.description: Create algorithms (a series of ordered steps) to solve a problem.
Design a solution to a complex real-world problem by breaking it down into smaller, more manageable problems that can be solved through engineering.
Compare and contrast data collected by different groups in order to discuss similarities and differences in their findings.
